hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Partition
hints.text: Notice that for any split point, the suffix sum equals the total sum minus the prefix sum.

hints.title: Running Balance
hints.text: Precalculate the sum of the whole array, then iterate through each valid cut position updating prefix sum.

hints.title: Absolute Difference Minimization
hints.text: Track the minimum value of absolute difference between prefix and suffix across all indices from 0 to n - 2.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def splitArrayWithMinimumDifference(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        total_sum = sum(nums)
        prefix = 0
        min_diff = float('inf')
        for i in range(len(nums) - 1):
            prefix += nums[i]
            suffix = total_sum - prefix
            min_diff = min(min_diff, abs(prefix - suffix))
        return min_diff
```

complexity.notes: Single pass prefix computation with constant extra space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing subarray sums from scratch at every partition index costs O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space by maintaining running prefix sum.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that partition sums can be derived in linear time via total sum subtraction.
